system.name: Solo Travel Security Gemini Grounded Intelligence Engine

layers.name: Python Intelligence Harvester

frameworks.name: google-genai
frameworks.purpose: Official Gemini API SDK with Search Grounding

frameworks.name: pillow
frameworks.purpose: Image EXIF metadata stripping and resizing

responsibilities: Execute Google Search Grounding queries against authoritative transport/consular sources
Enforce token-level constrained decoding via Pydantic response_schema
Manage Gemini Context Caches for long-lived municipal regulatory corpora
Parse visual inputs (taxi meters, prescription labels, room doors) under multimodal schemas

layers.name: Laravel Application & Queue Gateway

frameworks.name: laravel/framework
frameworks.purpose: Core application orchestration and dependency injection

frameworks.name: laravel/horizon
frameworks.purpose: Redis queue management and throughput telemetry

frameworks.name: nuwave/lighthouse
frameworks.purpose: Declarative GraphQL SDL schema and field resolvers

responsibilities: Dispatch parallel harvesting jobs to Redis queues via Horizon
Act as an airlock firewall stripping user IP, user-agent, and session metadata
Validate Python JSON outputs against canonical JSON schemas before DB insertion
Execute automated diffs against existing PostgreSQL rows to detect fare/timetable changes
Trigger webhooks to recompile static pSEO pages when authoritative data changes

layers.name: PostgreSQL Relational & Document Store
layers.storageFormat: Relational Foreign Keys + JSONB Document Payloads

document: GIN (jsonb_path_ops) on payload, truth_table, and scoring_matrix

layers.name: Laravel Lighthouse GraphQL Gateway
responsibilities: Serve pre-harvested LEGO blocks with deterministic schema guarantees

layers.name: Next.js Static & Sovereign Client
responsibilities: Render sub-20ms edge-cached landing pages and travel portals
Execute client-side Truth Table binary evaluation without server round-trips
Compute arrival risk scores locally via algebraic combiner engine
